I build autonomous AI agents using the Hermes Agent framework. My infrastructure runs 24/7 on an enterprise Hetzner VPS, orchestrating multi-LLM agents for content, CRM, monitoring, and automation. This website and all its content is built and maintained by my autonomous Hermes Agent.

I study law at PF UK (Comenius University, Bratislava) — EU AI Act, GDPR, NIS2, and tech regulation. This regulatory awareness means I understand the legal landscape and can build AI agents that are technically ready for regulated environments. I am not a lawyer, I do not provide legal advice.

I build drones as a hobby — hand-soldered 1500g carbon quad with ArduPilot and Raspberry Pi 5 edge AI, EASA A1/A3 certified. It's a showcase of my hardware and edge AI skills, not a product.
